━━━ /pay ━━━
(sends)
💸 Pay a player
Name the player in one of these ways:
• Telegram username: /pay @username
• Player code: /pay K7Q2M9A
You can add the amount and the method: /pay K7Q2M9A 5000 card
Cash changes hands only when you are both in the same city; card payments work from anywhere.

  [🔎 Find a player] → social:search
  [🔙 Back] → bank:show
